items.title: Tulsa Mourns Loss of TU Hall of Famer F.A. Dry
items.summary: The University of Tulsa mourns the passing of TU Athletic Hall of Famer F.A. Dry, a former head football coach and director of athletics who guided the Golden Hurricane to four consecutive Missouri Valley Conference championships. Dry was inducted into The University of Tulsa Athletic Hall of Fame in 2019 in recognition of his contributions as an assistant football coach, director of athletics and head football coach.

items.title: Concert and Tailgate Experience Set for Florida Atlantic
items.summary: Tulsa fans can begin Saturday's Homecoming football festivities at Chapman Commons, where the Golden Hurricane Tailgate will feature live music, food, drinks and activities for fans of all ages.

items.title: Baylor Hayes heating up at the right time for Tulsa
items.summary: Baylor Hayes threw for a career-high 338 yards and 4 TDs in Tulsa's win at Tulane. Now the Golden Hurricane QB looks to keep rolling against FAU.

items.title: WATCH: Tre Lamb Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: Tulsa Head Football Coach Tre Lamb met with the media Monday as the Golden Hurricane prepares to return home for Saturday's American Conference matchup against Florida Atlantic at H.A. Chapman Stadium.

items.title: Singleton Jr. Added to Biletnikoff Award Watch List
items.summary: Tulsa wide receiver Oran Singleton Jr. has been added to the 2026 Biletnikoff Award Watch List, the Tallahassee Quarterback Club Foundation announced Monday, Nov. 9. The award annually recognizes the outstanding receiver in college football.

items.title: Tulsa's Baylor Hayes Named Manning Award Star of the Week
items.summary: Tulsa quarterback Baylor Hayes has been named one of eight Manning Award Stars of the Week following his career performance in the Golden Hurricane's 60-10 road victory over Tulane on Saturday, Nov. 7.

items.title: Tulsa Football Announces Kickoff Time for Home Finale Against Charlotte
items.summary: The American Conference has announced the kickoff time and television network for Tulsa's upcoming home football game against Charlotte.

items.title: Tulsa put on a show in stunning 60-10 rout of Tulane
items.summary: Tulsa football dominated Tulane 60-10 behind Baylor Hayes' 338 yards and 4 touchdowns, Oran Singleton's 3 scores and a 6-sack defensive performance.

items.title: Tulsa Rolls Past Tulane, 60-10
items.summary: The Tulsa Golden Hurricane secured their fifth win of the season in convincing fashion with a 60-10 win over the Tulane Green Wave. The 60 points are the most in the Tre Lamb era and the most in program history over Tulane.

items.title: Tulsa's bowl hopes still alive as Golden Hurricane visit Tulane
items.summary: Tulsa visits Tulane as the Hurricane look to turn close losses into wins and keep bowl eligibility hopes alive. Get the full matchup preview.

items.title: Tulsa Continues American Conference Play at Tulane
items.summary: Tulsa returns from its open week to face Tulane on Saturday, Nov. 7, at Yulman Stadium in New Orleans. Kickoff is scheduled for 11 a.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: Tulen Named to Ray Guy Award Watch List
items.summary: Tulsa punter Max Tulen has been named to the 2026 Ray Guy Midseason Award Watch List, the Augusta Sports Council announced.

items.title: Tulane coach sees a dangerous Tulsa team: 'They are literally inches away'
items.summary: Tulane coach Will Hall praised Tre Lamb, Baylor Hayes and Tulsa's improved defense, explaining why he believes the Hurricane are better than their record.

items.title: Tre Lamb: Tulsa has 'a ton to play for' during final four games
items.summary: Tulsa is 4-4 with four games remaining. Tre Lamb discusses the healthier roster, bowl eligibility and the opportunity for an eight-win season.

items.title: Chris Thompson Jr. Named to Comeback Player of the Year Midseason Watch List
items.summary: Tulsa graduate linebacker Chris Thompson Jr. has been named to the 2026 Comeback Player of the Year Award Midseason Watch List, College Sports Communicators announced Monday in association with The Associated Press and Fiesta Sports Foundation.

items.title: Tulsa Football turns its focus to bowl eligibility with four games remaining
items.summary: Tulsa football needs two wins in its final four games to become bowl eligible. Tre Lamb explains why reaching a bowl matters to the program.

items.title: Tre Lamb: Tulsa must 'learn how to win' close games

items.summary: Tulsa blew a late lead in a heartbreaking 38-35 loss to Army after a missed field goal, blocked punt and last-second kick doomed the Golden Hurricane.
